description: This file defines a Smarty plugin function 'sugarvar_connector' that generates a connector button script for a specified module in SuiteCRM/SugarCRM. It includes license headers, security checks, and invokes external connector utility methods.

methods.name: smarty_function_sugarvar_connector
methods.description: Generates and outputs a connector button script based on the module specified in Smarty display parameters; errors if 'module' parameter is missing.
